mapper.select: SELECT r.ABR_SN AS reportSn, rt.TRD_SN AS tradeSn, r.RPRT_USR_SN AS reporterUserSn, r.ABR_STATUS_CD AS reportStatusCode, rt.ABR_TRD_RSLT_CD AS tradeDecisionResultCode, rt.ABR_TRD_PREV_STATUS_CD AS previousTradeStatusCode, rt.ABR_TRD_REMAIN_SEC AS remainingAutoCompleteSeconds, (rt.ABR_TRD_STLM_HOLD_YN = 'Y') AS settlementHoldApplied, (rt.ABR_TRD_CHAT_CLOSE_YN = 'Y') AS chatClosed, t.TRD_TYPE_CD AS tradeTypeCode, t.TRD_STATUS_CD AS tradeStatusCode, t.BID_SN AS bidSn, t.SLLR_USR_SN AS sellerUserSn, t.BYPR_USR_SN AS buyerUserSn, t.REQ_USR_SN AS requesterUserSn, t.PRV_USR_SN AS providerUserSn FROM ABUSE_REPORT r JOIN ABUSE_REPORT_TRADE rt ON rt.ABR_SN = r.ABR_SN JOIN TRADE t ON t.TRD_SN = rt.TRD_SN WHERE r.ABR_SN = #{reportSn} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE TRADE SET TRD_UPDT_ID = CASE WHEN #{targetStatusCode} = 'TRDC0005' THEN TRD_UPDT_ID ELSE #{updaterId} END, TRD_STATUS_CD = #{targetStatusCode}, TRD_AUTO_CMPL_DT = CASE WHEN #{targetStatusCode} = 'TRDC0005' THEN DATE_ADD( NOW(), INTERVAL GREATEST(COALESCE(#{remainingSeconds}, 0), 1) SECOND ) ELSE NULL END, TRD_UPDT_DT = NOW() WHERE TRD_SN = #{tradeSn} AND TRD_STATUS_CD = #{expectedStatusCode}

UPDATE ABUSE_REPORT_TRADE rt JOIN ABUSE_REPORT r ON r.ABR_SN = rt.ABR_SN SET rt.ABR_TRD_RSLT_CD = #{resultCode}, rt.ABR_TRD_UPDT_ID = #{updaterId}, rt.ABR_TRD_UPDT_DT = NOW() WHERE rt.ABR_SN = #{reportSn} AND r.ABR_STATUS_CD IN ('ABSC0001', 'ABSC0002')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TRADE_STATUS_HIST ( TRD_SN, TRD_STS_HST_STATUS_CD, TRD_STS_HST_RSN_CN, TRD_STS_HST_REG_ID, TRD_STS_HST_UPDT_ID ) VALUES ( #{tradeSn}, #{statusCode}, #{reason}, #{updaterId}, #{updaterId} )
